Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Sectt. Lko
Counsel for Applicant :- Shailendra Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.58 of 2024, under Section 498A, 304B Ipc &
Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Ramgaon, District Bahraich.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant argues that co-accused i.e. father-in-law has been granted bail vide order dated 29.07.2024.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

sentences.text: 5. Considering and adopting the reasoning as contained in the order dated 29.07.2024, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Fatima @ Kanee be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
